import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, SplineTransformer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")


# Extract comment text (remove surrounding quotes and unescape)
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text)
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        text = text[1:-1]
    text = text.replace("\\n", " ").replace("\\t", " ").replace("  ", " ")
    return text.strip()


# Apply cleaning
train["clean_comment"] = train["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test["clean_comment"] = test["Comment"].apply(clean_text)


# Extract date features
def extract_date_features(date_str):
    if pd.isna(date_str) or date_str == "":
        return [0, 0, 0, 0]
    try:
        date_str = str(date_str).replace("Z", "")
        year = int(date_str[0:4]) if len(date_str) >= 4 else 2000
        month = int(date_str[4:6]) if len(date_str) >= 6 else 1
        day = int(date_str[6:8]) if len(date_str) >= 8 else 1
        hour = int(date_str[8:10]) if len(date_str) >= 10 else 0
        return [year, month, day, hour]
    except:
        return [0, 0, 0, 0]


train["year"], train["month"], train["day"], train["hour"] = zip(
    *train["Date"].apply(extract_date_features)
)
test["year"], test["month"], test["day"], test["hour"] = zip(
    *test["Date"].apply(extract_date_features)
)


# Text features
def text_features(text):
    text = str(text)
    return [
        len(text),
        len(text.split()),
        len(re.findall(r"[A-Z]", text)) / max(len(text), 1),
        len(re.findall(r"[!?,]", text)),
        len(re.findall(r"\d", text)),
        len(re.findall(r"[^\w\s]", text)),
        text.count('"'),
        text.count("#"),
        text.count("@"),
    ]


train_text_feat = np.array([text_features(t) for t in train["clean_comment"]])
test_text_feat = np.array([text_features(t) for t in test["clean_comment"]])

# TF-IDF features (character-level n-grams)
tfidf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000,
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    analyzer="char",
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# TF-IDF features (word-level n-grams)
tfidf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=3000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    analyzer="word",
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Fit transformers on combined train+test
all_comments = list(train["clean_comment"]) + list(test["clean_comment"])
tfidf_char.fit(all_comments)
tfidf_word.fit(all_comments)

# Transform
train_char_tfidf = tfidf_char.transform(train["clean_comment"])
test_char_tfidf = tfidf_char.transform(test["clean_comment"])
train_word_tfidf = tfidf_word.transform(train["clean_comment"])
test_word_tfidf = tfidf_word.transform(test["clean_comment"])

# Scale structural features
scaler = StandardScaler()
train_text_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(train_text_feat)
test_text_scaled = scaler.transform(test_text_feat)

# Combine features
X_train = hstack([train_char_tfidf, train_word_tfidf, csr_matrix(train_text_scaled)])
X_test = hstack([test_char_tfidf, test_word_tfidf, csr_matrix(test_text_scaled)])
y_train = train["Insult"].values

# XGBoost parameters (optimized for AUC)
xgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary:logistic",
    "eval_metric": "auc",
    "eta": 0.02,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "min_child_weight": 10,
    "gamma": 0.1,
    "lambda": 1.0,
    "alpha": 0.1,
    "seed": 42,
    "verbosity": 0,
}

# 3-fold cross-validation for better time efficiency
n_splits = 3
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
oof_preds = np.zeros(X_train.shape[0])
test_preds = np.zeros(X_test.shape[0])
cv_scores = []

for fold_idx, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train, y_train)):
    X_tr, X_val = X_train[train_idx], X_train[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y_train[train_idx], y_train[val_idx]

    # Convert sparse matrix to dense for XGBoost (more efficient for text features)
    dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X_tr.tocsr(), label=y_tr)
    dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val.tocsr(), label=y_val)

    model = xgb.train(
        xgb_params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=1000,
        evals=[(dtrain, "train"), (dval, "eval")],
        early_stopping_rounds=100,
        verbose_eval=False,
    )

    val_pred = model.predict(dval)
    oof_preds[val_idx] = val_pred
    fold_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
    cv_scores.append(fold_auc)

    # Predict on test set
    dtest = xgb.DMatrix(X_test.tocsr())
    test_pred = model.predict(dtest)
    test_preds += test_pred / n_splits

    print(f"Fold {fold_idx + 1} AUC: {fold_auc:.6f}")

# Calculate mean CV score
mean_cv_auc = np.mean(cv_scores)
print(f"\nMean CV AUC: {mean_cv_auc:.6f}")

# Create submission file with proper format
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Comment": test["Comment"].values,
        "Date": test["Date"].values,
        "Insult": test_preds,
    }
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
